    StartersChicharronesPork belly roasted till the skin shatters, salt and malt vinegar, pickled onions, hot mustard.From the hot table, 4.00 per half pound.How to make it1kg boneless pork belly, skin on4 tsp malt vinegar1 tbsp salt1 tsp flaky sea salt1 jar pickled onions2 tbsp hot English mustardScore the skin of the pork belly, pat dry and refrigerate uncovered overnight to dry it out.Rub the skin with 1 tbsp of the malt vinegar, then the salt.Roast skin up at 160°C.Raise to 240°C and roast until puffed and crackling.Rest, then cut into bite-sized pieces.Sprinkle with the flaky salt mixed with the last 1 tsp of malt vinegar. Serve with pickled onions and hot mustard.Pan-Fried Pork DumplingsSix, crisp underneath, with soy, black vinegar and ginger to dip.Six for 3.25. Chinatown is blocks 13 to 15.How to make it24 frozen pork dumplings1 tbsp oil120ml water3 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp black vinegar1 tbsp ginger, cut into fine matchsticksMix the soy, black vinegar and ginger for dipping.Fry the dumplings flat side down in oil.Add the water, cover and steam.Uncover and fry again until crisp underneath.Serve straight from the pan with the dip.MainsChopped Beef & CheeseGround chuck and onions worked fine on the griddle, melted American, lettuce, tomato, mayo, toasted hero.Free delivery within 16 blocks.How to make it1 brown onion, diced600g beef mince6 slices of American cheese4 hero rolls1/2 iceberg lettuce, shredded2 tomatoes, sliced80g mayonnaise1 tbsp oilsalt and pepper, to tasteFry the onion in the oil on a hot griddle until soft.Add the mince and chop it up with a spatula as it browns, seasoning well with salt and pepper.Lay the cheese on top and chop through until melted.Toast the rolls. Pile in the meat with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise.SweetsChocolate Birthday CakeBy the slice, two cocoa layers, dark buttercream. Whole cake 16.00, any name on top.Whole cake 16.00, 24 hours notice. Candles free.How to make it350g butter, softened200g caster sugar4 eggs220g self-raising flour80g cocoa120ml milk300g icing sugar1 pack birthday candlesHeat the oven to 180°C and line two 20cm tins.Beat the first batch of butter with the caster sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, half the cocoa and the milk.Bake in the two tins.Cool the cakes completely.Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and remaining cocoa.Sandwich and cover the cakes with the buttercream and add candles.DrinksSweet Iced CoffeeSeattle-style dark roast over ice, condensed milk from the can, pinch of cinnamon.For the long walk to court.How to make it60g ground coffee600ml water, boiling8 tbsp sweetened condensed milk1 bag iceground cinnamon, to dustBrew the coffee strong with the boiling water and let it cool.Spoon condensed milk into each of 4 glasses.Fill with ice and pour the coffee over.Stir well until creamy and dust with cinnamon.
